themes: Adam and the knowledge of names

narrative_passages.title: Ibrahim and Ismail raise the House
The town and the hundred years
narrative_passages.treatment_reason: a man made to die for a hundred years and raised again; kept to the reading

summary_for_children: Al-Baqarah is the longest surah. It shows how Allah guides people, tells of Adam, of the Children of Israel and the cow, of Ibrahim building the House, and teaches about charity, patience and good character.
environment_concept: A green valley of guidance: an orchard where hidden things are found by name (2:31), a meadow of cows (2:67), great foundation stones (2:127), a river to cross (2:249) and a field where one seed grows seven spikes (2:261).
architecture_and_scenery: Terraced valley with a garden of names, a pastoral meadow, stone foundations of an ancient house, a river crossing and fields of grain.

palette.lighting: Warm midday sun turning to clear evening

areas.name: Garden of Names
areas.description: Objects around the glade reveal their names when found.

areas.name: Meadow of the Cow
areas.description: A pasture recalling the account; the people are never shown.

areas.name: Foundations of the House
areas.description: Great foundation stones by a quiet valley.

areas.name: River Crossing
areas.description: A river whose ayah is read before crossing; a lesson on patience.

areas.name: Field of Seven Spikes
areas.description: A field where one seed grows into seven spikes of grain.

activities.name: Plant the seed of charity
activities.description: Plant three seeds; each one grows seven spikes of grain.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Find the names
activities.description: Find five glowing things hidden in the orchard.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Lay the foundations
activities.description: Carry four great stones to the foundations.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator guides from glade to glade, separating what the Quran states from explanation, and reads each glade's ayah.
learning_objectives: Name the main stories in Al-Baqarah
Explain the seed example of charity
Understand that knowledge comes from Allah

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (foundations, grain, herd, orchard, river) with 3 hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 960x600; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene and the in-scene activities

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Great Story Atlas
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A hub-and-doors adventure: the atlas hall sends you into four story lands, each with its own kind of play. The village is an investigation in which you narrow a herd down by each answer in turn.

unique_world.visual_theme: Story atlas hall with a lit floor map and doors to separate lands

primary_mechanic.text: Choose story lands from an atlas; in the cow land, hear each description in the Quran's order (2:67-71) and send away cows that do not match.

secondary_activities: ordered corner walk round a low outline (2:125-129)
unique_world.narrative_structure: Hub and spokes: atlas hall with story doors
unique_world.learning_objective: Follow the questions about the cow in order and see the surah as many stories
